Rules of the ride

  • Minimum 30 minutes, every day, no exceptions and no banking ahead.
  • A ride under 30 minutes counts as a short day, not a zero — log it honestly.
  • Commentary is part of the deal. The numbers alone will not keep you on the bike.
  • Anything saved in the browser is yours alone until it is copied into the thread.

Self-contained page: no external scripts, fonts or stylesheets, so it renders the same offline as online. Canonical data lives in data.json next to this file — ask PlayerZero to add a note or refresh the ride data and this page gets rebuilt.

Internal use only. The PELOTON wordmark here is a typographic stand-in, not Peloton's official mark, and instructor tiles use generated monograms until real photos are dropped into assets/instructors/.
